subject.title: fix(browser): reject loose click coordinate numbers when normalizing actions

question: Should direct Browser `/act` coordinate strings adopt the CLI’s ordinary-decimal grammar, dropping shipped support for scientific notation and trailing-dot decimals?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but it intentionally narrows shipped route input syntax; only a maintainer can confirm that consistency with the CLI outweighs compatibility for existing direct callers.

options.title: Align route with CLI
options.body: Accept the compatibility tightening and land the shared decimal parser with the supplied route, CLI, and live behavior proof.

options.title: Preserve shipped route forms
options.body: Keep the general finite-number parser for `/act` and close or revise this PR if scientific notation and trailing-dot decimals must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Align route with CLI
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility tightening and land the shared decimal parser with the supplied route, CLI, and live behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He reviewed and merged the overlapping route contract change and is best positioned to decide the permanent Browser input grammar.
